migration.approvalRule: AI-extracted candidates remain unapproved until a human decision receipt pins the source hashes.

attention.title: Human review is required for repository policy extraction
attention.humanSummary: No effective policies are installed yet. Extract source-linked candidates and have a human review them before promotion.

attention.title: Confirm which initiative should group existing work
attention.humanSummary: No initiative candidate connects policy and guideline direction to delivery work yet. Review source-backed candidates after existing projects and design evidence are analyzed, or confirm why the evidence is insufficient.

gaps.summary: Source-linked policy candidates have not yet been reviewed by a human.
gaps.reason: The initializer does not invent repository policy or approve it on its own.

gaps.summary: No initiative candidate has been created to connect existing projects with policies and guidelines.
gaps.reason: AI may extract outcomes, scope, and success criteria from existing documents and code, but it cannot issue or approve an initiative on its own.
